---
title: Make a system
description: Define models, contracts, a frontend, and its aggregate-owned authentication with Zerospin make methods.
---

This guide shows the direct shape for defining a small system. It keeps each exported piece visible so the relationships between models, contracts, frontend, aggregate owner, and system are easy to inspect.

## Imports

Import the builders, primitive descriptors, typed error shape, and Effect schema tools used by the system.

```ts
import { makeContract } from '@zerospin/core/contracts/makeContract.js';
import { makeFrontendController } from '@zerospin/core/frontendController/makeFrontendController.js';
import { ZerospinError } from '@zerospin/error';
import { makeModelIdSchema } from '@zerospin/core/models/makeIdSchema.js';
import { makeModel } from '@zerospin/core/models/makeModel.js';
import { makeSelection } from '@zerospin/core/models/makeSelection.js';
import { primitives } from '@zerospin/core/models/primitives.js';
import { makeSystem } from '@zerospin/core/system/makeSystem.js';
import { Effect, Schema } from 'effect';
```

## Models

Models define the resource types in the system. Each call provides one complete current definition followed by its complete historical definitions; these first-version models have empty history arrays. The `User` model supplies this aggregate's user identity. `List` belongs to a user, and `Item` belongs to a list.

```ts
export const User = makeModel(
  {
    abbreviation: 'usr',
    modelName: 'user',
    attributes: {
      name: primitives.text(),
    },
    indexes: [],
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
  [],
);

export const List = makeModel(
  {
    abbreviation: 'lst',
    modelName: 'list',
    attributes: {
      name: primitives.text(),
      userId: primitives.ref({
        table: User.table,
        relation: 'user',
        inverse: 'lists',
      }),
    },
    indexes: [],
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
  [],
);

export const Item = makeModel(
  {
    abbreviation: 'tsk',
    modelName: 'item',
    attributes: {
      listId: primitives.ref({
        table: List.table,
        relation: 'list',
        inverse: 'items',
      }),
      name: primitives.text(),
    },
    indexes: [],
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
  [],
);
```

## Contracts

Contracts define commands. Each contract has a payload shape, an explicit mutation schema, and a `program` whose Effect result matches that schema. Mutation schemas and constructors belong to the versioned model definition.

`createList` creates a `List` resource and stores the user relationship on `userId`.

```ts
export const createList = makeContract({
  commandName: 'createList',
  payload: {
    id: List.primaryKey({ autogenerate: false }),
    name: primitives.text(),
    userId: User.primaryKey({ autogenerate: false }),
  },
  mutations: Schema.Struct({
    created: List.createMutation('1.0.0'),
  }),
  program: props => {
    const { payload } = props;
    const { id, name, userId } = payload;
    return Effect.all({
      created: List.create('1.0.0', {
        resourceId: id,
        attributes: {
          name,
          userId,
        },
      }),
    });
  },
  version: '1.0.0',
});
```

`createItem` creates an `Item` resource and stores the list relationship on `listId`.

```ts
export const createItem = makeContract({
  commandName: 'createItem',
  payload: {
    id: Item.primaryKey({ autogenerate: false }),
    listId: List.primaryKey({ autogenerate: false }),
    name: primitives.text(),
  },
  mutations: Schema.Struct({
    created: Item.createMutation('1.0.0'),
  }),
  program: props => {
    const { payload } = props;
    const { id, listId, name } = payload;
    return Effect.all({
      created: Item.create('1.0.0', {
        resourceId: id,
        attributes: {
          listId,
          name,
        },
      }),
    });
  },
  version: '1.0.0',
});
```

`updateList` changes the list name with the `List` model's matching versioned update schema and constructor.

```ts
export const updateList = makeContract({
  commandName: 'updateList',
  payload: {
    id: List.primaryKey({ autogenerate: false }),
    name: primitives.text(),
  },
  mutations: Schema.Struct({
    updated: List.updateMutation('1.0.0'),
  }),
  program: props => {
    const { payload } = props;
    const { id, name } = payload;
    return Effect.all({
      updated: List.update('1.0.0', {
        resourceId: id,
        attributes: { name },
      }),
    });
  },
  version: '1.0.0',
});
```

## Frontend

The frontend names the command surface and model set for one aggregate-owned UI. It repeats the owner's exact user-ID schema so `makeSystem` can reject a mismatch before constructing the System.

```ts
export const listFrontend = makeFrontendController({
  systemName: 'system1',
  aggregateName: 'user',
  frontendName: 'main',
  version: '1.0.0',
  contracts: {
    createList,
    createItem,
    updateList,
  },
  models: {
    list: List,
    item: Item,
    user: User,
  },
  signature: Schema.Struct({
    userId: makeModelIdSchema(User),
  }),
  userId: makeModelIdSchema(User),
});
```

## System and owner authentication

The aggregate owns one user-ID schema and one authenticator for all of its frontends. Zerospin first adapts the selected frontend signature, then supplies only that binding's resolved model database. The authenticator returns the exact schema-derived `userId`; selections use the same value to define the aggregate frontend graph.

```ts
export const system = makeSystem({
  name: 'system1',
  version: '1.0.1',
  aggregates: {
    user: {
      userId: makeModelIdSchema(User),
      authenticate: ({ signature, db }) =>
        Effect.gen(function* () {
          const user = yield* Effect.promise(() =>
            db.query.user.findFirst({
              where: { id: { eq: signature.userId } },
            }),
          );
          if (user === undefined) {
            return yield* new ZerospinError({
              code: 'user-not-found',
              message: `User ${signature.userId} was not found`,
            });
          }
          return user.id;
        }),
      models: { user: User, list: List, item: Item },
      contracts: { createList, createItem, updateList },
      selections: {
        user: makeSelection({
          model: User,
          where: ({ userId }) => ({ id: userId }),
        }),
        list: makeSelection({
          model: List,
          where: ({ userId }) => ({ user: { id: userId } }),
        }),
        item: makeSelection({
          model: Item,
          where: ({ userId }) => ({
            list: { user: { id: userId } },
          }),
        }),
      },
      frontends: {
        main: { controller: listFrontend },
      },
    },
  },
});
```
